title: Enhanced lithium storage in silicon anodes via Sn–Ni heterostructures and graphene conductive networks: interface regulation mechanisms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26623-26638
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02735K, Paper

Li Zhen, Xie Jianing, Sun Lin, Zhang Dawei, Chu Fengfei, Shao Sijia, Wang Xiaomin
This graphical abstract presents Sn–Ni@Si/graphene anodes for Li-ion batteries. Sn–Ni interfacial phases and graphene improve electron transport, buffer Si volume change, and stabilize interfaces, enabling high ICE and cycling stability.
